name: Telegram Quick Toolkit
description: Direct Telegram commands (starting with '/') handled without the LLM: inline keyboard menu, quick info, daemon management (yui-watchdog.sh + yui-debug.sh + PM2), tool rebuild, and Yui internal tool access for admins (/bash, /img, /ls, /cat, /get).

enabled.label: Enable Toolkit
enabled.description: Enable quick Telegram commands handled directly without the LLM.

showMenuHint.label: Show /menu hint
showMenuHint.description: When an unknown '/' command is received, show the command list and inline keyboard menu.

usePm2.label: Use PM2 (optional)
usePm2.description: DEFAULT is no PM2 (watchdog + yui-debug.sh, single-process daemon). When enabled, YuiHime runs as a PM2 daemon via tools/yui-pm2.sh — the local watchdog is skipped.
